scope: Directly compiled injector policy and first-owned-host snapshot selector helpers; exclusively owned local files, real reparse objects, data-only self exports and authoritative self-token queries. No remote thread, runtime or add-on loading, graphics, desktop input or games.
cases: Strict architecture-specific preload leaf grammar and malformed fields
Build-ID and advertised eight-byte SHA-256 prefix binding
Unique NAME and stock wildcard filename disable rules, including the fixed reserved EGO filename
Complete five-field owned-run JSON marker grammar, exact types and directory identity, lowercase UUIDv4/variant, native ISO-shape semantics, supported escapes and decoded Unicode
Known SHA-256 vector, full equal/changed file hashes, held deny-write/delete guards, missing/empty/directory/actual-symlink rejection and cleanup

First-host snapshot path, target-tree exclusion, runtime/base/AddonPath identity, exact ASCII and no-BOM strict JSON ownership markers, required files, full candidate hash, held file/directory guards, actual ancestor junction and actual reparse candidate rejection
Independent authoritative self-token privilege oracle and missing/non-process target rejection
Actual self module/export inspection distinguishes dormant member and completed adapter
sourceConfigureGuard: The foreign-host loading predicate admits (ready || adapter_ready) when the owned late-host capability is absent.

compatibilityScope.readyMeaningUnchanged: Baseline AdapterReadyV1=1 is accepted without fabricating authenticated MemberReady/ReadyV1.
compatibilityScope.manualStockHostLimit: An older injector requiring member readiness may time out on a manually configured stock-only host while every preloaded app is offline/dormant.
compatibilityScope.currentSdkScope: The SDK preloads only the latest project-owned hosts, whose existing gate/adapter-readiness path supports older SDK joins. Universal older-injector admission on manually configured stock hosts is not claimed.

retainedEarlierAttempt.observedError: CreateFileW returned ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND (3) for a 269-character fixture-owned candidate path.
retainedEarlierAttempt.causeAndCorrection: The deeper new build directory and real 102-character registered leaf exceeded the fixture's ordinary Win32 path budget. The fixture now uses extended-length paths for its own file I/O, preserving the full leaf and layout. Production injector code already used extended-length paths; no production check was relaxed.
retainedEarlierAttempt.productionAttribution: None. The failed setup had not invoked the snapshot selector.

warnings: The included injector retains pre-existing C4457 variable shadowing outside this feature.
limits: The selector uses known dummy native bytes. Full-byte equality binds it to a separately validated staged PE/BID/ABI in production; these cases do not replace that caller validation.
No fixture invokes the first-host LoadLibrary/Activate branch, grants that branch to an existing host, or proves remote ownership behavior; separate copied-loader fixtures cover those boundaries.
This does not prove dormant scanner behavior, mixed-app route isolation, hook recovery, rendering, input or foreign-installation preservation.
Measured thunk sizes belong to these helper fixture binaries; each standalone injector also enforces its own compiled bounds.
